name: GQ Electronics GMC-600 Pro Geiger Counter
summary: A documented LND 7317 pancake-tube Geiger counter for radiation counting and logging. Interpret its count and dose displays within detector limits; measurement provides no physical radiation protection.
description: The GMC-600 Pro is for users prepared to learn radiation counting, establish background conditions and interpret a detector response within a defined procedure. GQ documents an LND 7317 pancake Geiger tube with sensitivity to alpha, beta, gamma and X-ray radiation. A detected count does not identify an isotope or establish that food, water, a location or a person is safe. Counts per minute and counts per second describe count rate; displayed dose-rate values depend on conversion and energy response. For a safety-critical dose assessment, seek an appropriately selected and calibrated instrument and qualified advice rather than reading a consumer display as a clearance decision. Compared with the existing FNIRSI GC-01 profile, the documented detector design and intended measurement task matter more than the colour of a screen. Neither device is shielding, protective clothing or a substitute for emergency instructions.

specs.label: Documented response
specs.value: Alpha, beta, gamma and X-ray; response depends on radiation energy and measurement conditions

specs.label: Count units
specs.value: CPM and CPS; count-rate displays are distinct from dose-rate estimates

specs.label: Dose display units
specs.value: µSv/h and mR/h documented in the manual; displayed conversion is not universal dose accuracy

specs.label: Logging
specs.value: Internal memory logging, USB communication and Wi-Fi server logging; remote services require connectivity

specs.label: Current vendor revision
specs.value: Current store describes a colour LCD and USB Type-C. Older manual describes a monochrome LCD and mini-USB; match the delivered revision before buying.

specs.label: Power
specs.value: Internal rechargeable 3.6/3.7 V battery and USB power; replacement compatibility must follow the exact revision instructions

pros: A documented pancake-tube identity helps a buyer ask specific questions about the measurement task and detector response.
Count-rate and historical logging can support a repeatable background-comparison exercise when used with an appropriate procedure.
Local logging and USB power provide options separate from a Wi-Fi server connection.
cons: It does not identify radionuclides or measure all radiation types and energies equally; a low reading cannot clear an unknown hazard.
A pancake tube’s response and dose conversion must not be treated as a universal calibrated gamma dose measurement.
Current vendor page and older manual describe different display and USB hardware; the selected ASIN revision remains unverified.
useCases: Informed hobbyists learning background counting and instrument limitations without handling unknown radioactive materials.
Documenting repeat observations under a controlled procedure, with geometry, duration and background kept consistent.
Users comparing detector technologies for a defined task; professional safety decisions need suitably selected and calibrated equipment.

safetyNotes: A radiation detector measures a response; it provides no physical radiation protection and does not establish a safe exposure or safe location. Follow official emergency instructions and qualified radiation-safety advice.

CNSC guidance cautions against using a pancake contamination meter for gamma dose-rate surveys without an appropriate H*10 filter. No such filter, dose calibration or professional suitability is established for this selected offer.
Do not collect unknown sources, open suspect material or touch a potentially contaminated surface with the detector. Keep the sensitive detector window protected and follow the exact manual.
The artwork’s numbers are illustrative, not actual measurements, calibration results or safe-level thresholds. Do not use this profile to clear food, water or an unknown object.

purchaseChecks: Match GMC-600 Pro and confirm the LND 7317 detector; do not substitute GMC-600 Plus or another GQ model.
Ask which hardware revision is supplied: current colour/USB-C description differs from the older monochrome/mini-USB manual. Confirm the matching manual, battery and accessories.
For any measurement that affects safety, establish the required energy response, calibration, filter and procedure with a qualified specialist.
Compare the FNIRSI GC-01 reference for a different detector option, or a calibrated task-specific meter when dose assessment is required; no model is interchangeable merely because it displays µSv/h.
